note: Coach-editable. Depth is the rotation — Purple, then Gold, then White, and anybody after that is on the squad but in no rotation. A name may repeat: the same left tackle on all three is that name three times. Offense covers every spot the four formations use; defense is the 5-3, our everyday front.

offense_packages.note: Short yardage and goal line — size over speed at the three backfield spots. The line does not change.
